main_text.p: {ID.} Affectiones mixtorum externarum, quæ internas nō cōsequuntur, alias [?]
[?]iculte Id ευνηρα-ica rerum* um per Simplex, ut [?]apor
main_text.l: Ex qua & acredine contemperatis existit Acidi tas.

page.notes: The text is set sideways, so the line is read by turning the scan. Its opening "ID." may be a section mark rather than running text. The brace and its three small letters are not clear enough to read. The strip is rotated 90 degrees, so the lines are read from the side. The diagram braces are reduced to labels with a provisional level of 1, since the strip does not show how the boxes nest. The Greek word "ευνηρα-" is uncertain. The line "[?]iculte Id" lacks its first letter. The top fragment is too faint to read beyond a few letters. Only fragments of the line ends are visible; the start of each line is not on this part. The brace marks are drawn lines, not printed words. The Greek words are read from the fragment and may be incomplete. Greek lines are copied from the scan; the first and last Greek words are partly cut off at the left edge. The Latin label "Acidi tas" is printed with a space in the scan.
